messages.subject: Project Zephyr — FTO & validity opinion (final)
messages.plaintextBody:
James, Aisha,

Our freedom-to-operate and patent-validity opinion is attached (privileged). In short: overall FTO risk LOW; granted decentralised-control claims valid and not infringing the third-party cluster we identified; one dependent-claim caution on EP3892511. We recommend the IP indemnity be limited to use within the licensed field, which I see clause 7 already does, and that Penrose keep prosecuting the pending applications.

Nothing here should stop the deal proceeding.

Alan

Dr Alan Foster
Partner / Chartered Patent Attorney, Hartington IP
